This is a compilation of Munchengraph's 3 previous Apothecary Diaries doujins, with some new added pages and touched up artwork for others. Apparently, this is supposed to take place around volume 4 of the novels, according to the melonbooks page from the author. I do own 2 of the 3 individual books, so I might upload them another time, but this book is the definitive version of those, so enjoy.
